To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the configuration of the parallel arc consistency algorithm with less frequent communications, and the mean field annealing load balancing heuristic, yields the best speed-up on distributed memory machines.
the configuration with the most efficient use of memory and the most efficient communication yields the best results.

The use of arc-consistency algorithms on distributed memory machine can greatly reduce the size of the search space of constraint satisfaction problems by preprocessing and eliminating those variables which can never participate.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the use of distributed memory architectures for the implementation of constraint satisfaction algorithms and the use of parallel arc consistency algorithms to reduce the search space for the constraint satisfaction problem.
developing a framework for the design, analysis and implementation of parallel constraint satisfaction algorithms.
the design and implementation of parallel algorithms for constraint satisfaction problems on distributed memory machines.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a distributed memory machine can be used effectively to solve constraint satisfaction problems with a high number of variables and constraints.

the use of asynchronous algorithms with less frequent communications, combined with the use of mean field annealing to balance load, is a very efficient method of parallelizing constraint satisfaction algorithms.
a combination of the two variations in communications frequency and load balancing yields the most efficient algorithm.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, in order to achieve the best speedup, the parallel arc consistency algorithm should have the least number of communications with the minimum amount of data per communication.
the best speedup is obtained with the most infrequent communications, the most robust load balancing, and the most efficient use of the machine.
the use of parallel arc consistency algorithms is feasible and effective on distributed memory machines.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a simple, yet robust, heuristic can be used to improve the speedup of parallel arc consistency algorithms.
the frequency of communications between processors can be reduced to improve the performance of parallel algorithms.
the frequency of message passing and load balancing have a significant impact on the performance of the algorithm.
